review_loop.skill: /review-2 (two parallel read-only reviewers: bug-hunting debugger; architecture/quality/security/data-integrity auditor)
review_loop.verdict_before_addressing: Request Changes - 2 criticals after dedup, both corroborated: (1) a retry completing on another local day left the departed day's daily_aggregates row stale (fact/aggregate desync, reproduced by both reviewers); (2) the retry path dropped captured_at_utc/timezone/app provenance and the terminal seam's 'or now()' fallback parked the fact on the retry day (a fabricated instant against the contract's refusal rule). Warnings: WPM denominator summed seconds over the whole cohort while its jobs-count covered text-producing jobs only (AC04); exact_audio_join_coverage was tautological (joined incremented under the same condition as the denominator); capture_completeness counted excluded/deleted/expired examples in its denominator; nearing_expiry was a hardcoded 0; three emitted events missing from the contract list; date-fragile test fixtures (7-day windows over pinned 2026-09 instants); the readiness aggregates shipped without their cited suite assertions.
review_loop.addressed: Both criticals fixed with regression tests (the retry job dict carries the store rows' capture instant/zone/app; no instant fallback remains - the refusal rule now holds end to end; record_dictation_fact recomputes or deletes the departed day inside the same op; cross-day retry test + a general fact/aggregate invariant test added). Every warning fixed: WPM seconds now sum over the same text-producing cohort (whole-cohort minutes stay a separately labeled field); join coverage counts every envelope-named audio id as its denominator (a dangling id now lowers it - pinned by test); capture completeness denominates over live examples with a definition string; nearing_expiry is null with its note; the three events joined the contract list; fixtures widened to 3650-day windows; test_readiness_aggregates_m13 added to the cited suite. Suggestions applied: created_at_utc excluded from the retry upsert; daily()/summary() transform counts aligned (dead filter removed); the launch drift check also compares the aggregate algorithm version; local_day_for accepts the seconds-form instant; rebuild's zone assignment moved inside the writer op; the one-dictation-one-fact boundary (discard-short, abandoned captures, crash-recovered retries) documented in the contract. No findings rejected as incorrect; none deferred.
